title: Customers View OFF hides Customers from the top navigation
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View OFF.
custom_steps: 1. Log in and look at the top navigation.
custom_expected: Customers is not in the top navigation.
evidence: UI: the Time Clock User role (no customersView) shows top nav Work Orders | Schedule only — no Customers entry. Customers View OFF hides Customers from the top navigation.
